title: Hybrid Connectivity: VPN and Direct Connect
prompt: Design a hybrid architecture connecting an on-premises data center to AWS using both Direct Connect (primary) and Site-to-Site VPN (backup). Include a Transit Gateway for routing and show PrivateLink access to AWS services.
hints: Show the on-premises data center connecting via Direct Connect as primary path
Add a Site-to-Site VPN as a backup connection
Use Transit Gateway to route between on-premises and multiple VPCs
Include a PrivateLink endpoint for accessing AWS services privately
